camel_example: aliyun cms PutCustomEventRule --region cn-hangzhou --ContactGroups ECS_Group --RuleId CustomRuleId1 --Level CRITICAL --EventName HostDown --RuleName CustomeRule --GroupId 73780000 --Threshold 99
description_en: Calls the PutCustomEventRule operation to create an alert rule for a custom event
description_zh: 调用PutCustomEventRule接口创建自定义事件报警规则
kebab_example: aliyun cms put-custom-event-rule --group-id 73780000 --rule-id CustomRuleId1 --rule-name CustomeRule --event-name HostDown --contact-groups ECS_Group --threshold 99 --level CRITICAL --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PutCustomEventRule

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the application group. For information about how to obtain the ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115262.html.

A value of 0 indicates that the reported custom event does not belong to any application group
parameters.help_zh:
应用分组ID。获取方法请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115262.html。

0表示上报的自定义事件不属于任何一个应用分组
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the alert rule.

If the alert rule ID already exists, the alert rule is modified. If the alert rule ID does not exist, an alert rule is created
parameters.help_zh:
报警规则ID。

如果报警规则ID已存在，则表示修改报警规则；如果报警规则ID不存在，则表示创建报警规则
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the alert rule
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the custom event. For information about how to obtain the name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115262.html
parameters.help_zh: 自定义事件名称。获取方法请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115262.html
parameters.name: event_name

parameters.help_en: The alert contact group. Separate multiple contact groups with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 报警联系人组。多个联系人组之间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: contact_groups

parameters.help_en: The callback URL to which a POST request is sent when an alert is triggered
parameters.help_zh: 报警发生回调时指定的URL地址，向URL发送POST请求
parameters.name: webhook

parameters.help_en: The time period during which the alert rule is effective. Valid values: 00:00-23:59
parameters.help_zh: 报警规则生效的时间范围。取值范围：00:00-23:59
parameters.name: effective_interval

parameters.help_en: The aggregation period of the monitoring data for the custom event. Unit: seconds. The value must be 60 or a multiple of 60. Default value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 自定义事件监控数据的聚合周期。单位：秒。取值为60或60的整数倍。默认值：300
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The subject of the alert email
parameters.name: email_subject

parameters.help_en:
The alert level. Valid values:
CRITICAL
WARN
INFO
parameters.help_zh:
报警级别。取值：
CRITICAL：严重。
WARN：警告。
INFO：信息
parameters.name: level

Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
